svg.title: This smallness holds on a common tail: the radius census has rate zero, while M has rate −1/2, so the absorbed quantity has negative rate. All constants are chosen after the block side L, before the sector and the variation. Finally the real plate is the motion Gram matrix plus the identity on inactive coordinates. The exact normalization is ⟨v, formT form v⟩= scale2 X p ∥motion(u)p∥2.
